_comment: Differential-drive mobile robot (DDMR) with COM offset. The FUHAC paper never tabulates the robot's physical constants - it only names the Pioneer platform - so these are documented Pioneer 3-DX values, EXCEPT Kf which is calibrated (see _sources).

_sources.M_total: Pioneer 3-DX base mass (assumed; not in paper)
_sources.r_wheel: Pioneer 3-DX wheel radius (assumed; not in paper)
_sources.R_half_axle: Pioneer 3-DX half-wheelbase, 0.33 m track (assumed; not in paper)
_sources.I_A: estimated body inertia about the COM (assumed; not in paper)
_sources.I_0: estimated wheel inertia (assumed; not in paper)
_sources.Kf: CALIBRATED: at the ~3 m/s cruise the paper's paths demand, tau = Kf*v/r = 7.7 N.m, inside the paper's reported 5.9-9.7 N.m band (Table 2). It also sets the physical speed ceiling v_ss = r*tau_max/Kf = 5.85 m/s, which must exceed the fastest reference.
_sources.d_com: assumed non-zero COM offset; the paper's kinematic matrix requires d != 0
_sources.tau_max: paper Fig. 22: 'the wheel torques reach the saturation limits plotted (+/- 15 N.m)'
_sources.Ts_slow: paper: slow loop 150 ms; eps = Tf/Ts_slow = 0.2
